meta.title: Maestro — latest stable release demo
meta.author: dknauss
meta.description: In-place admin menu editor, with User Switching, an admin-bar user picker, and named test users (Adam Admin, Emma Editor, Andy Author, Carrie Contributor, Steven Subscriber) for trying per-role menu visibility. (installs the latest released version).

steps.command: wp user create editor editor@example.com --role=editor --user_pass=password --first_name=Emma --last_name=Editor --display_name="Emma Editor"
wp user create author author@example.com --role=author --user_pass=password --first_name=Andy --last_name=Author --display_name="Andy Author"
wp user create contributor contributor@example.com --role=contributor --user_pass=password --first_name=Carrie --last_name=Contributor --display_name="Carrie Contributor"
wp user create subscriber subscriber@example.com --role=subscriber --user_pass=password --first_name=Steven --last_name=Subscriber --display_name="Steven Subscriber"
